HOW TERRITORY EXCLUSIVITY WORKS

Request a manual review —
confirmed in writing.

This page prepares a review request for our directors. It does not check a live database or confirm territory availability automatically online.

1. Enter your sector and territory details

Submitting this form opens a formatted review request in your email app addressed to info@power-uptalent.co.uk (and provides a copyable text box below).

Territory review email ready to send in your email app

WHAT HAPPENS NEXT

From Review Request to Written Agreement

  • Step 1: Send the review email — Review and send the prepared email from your mail app to info@power-uptalent.co.uk.
  • Step 2: Manual mandate check (1 working day) — A director checks our current active client agreements in your sector and geographic region.
  • Step 3: Scope & boundary discussion — If the sector and region are open, we discuss the proposed roles, services and named competitor list.
  • Step 4: Confirmed in writing — Exclusivity takes effect only when the sector, territory, named competitors, service scope and duration are signed in a written partnership agreement.
PARTNERSHIP EXCLUSIVITY POLICY

What Exclusivity Covers

Where single-client exclusivity is agreed in writing for a partnership, Power-Up Talent commits not to headhunt for or represent the named direct competitors in that agreed sector and territory for the duration of the mandate.
